noise.label: Noise

entries.value_cubic: fn n_value_cubic(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return vnoise_cubic(p * mix(1.0, 12.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * 0.3 * k.y, 0.0), 11u); }
entries.perlin: fn n_perlin(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.5 * pnoise(p * mix(1.0, 12.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * 0.3 * k.y, 0.0), 13u); }
entries.simplex: fn n_simplex(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.5 * snoise(p * mix(1.0, 12.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * 0.3 * k.y, 0.0)); }
entries.perlin3d: fn n_perlin3d(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.5 * pnoise3(vec3f(p * mix(1.0, 12.0, k.x), t * mix(0.05, 1.0, k.y)), 17u); }
entries.turbulence: fn n_turbulence(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return turbulence(p * mix(0.5, 6.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * 0.2 * k.w, 0.0), i32(mix(1.0, 8.0, k.y)), 2.0, mix(0.3, 0.8, k.z), 23u) * 1.6; }
entries.billow:
// billow: fbm of |noise|, inverted — the puffy cloud look.
fn n_billow(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 1.0 - turbulence(p * mix(0.5, 6.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * 0.2 * k.w, 0.0), i32(mix(1.0, 8.0, k.y)), 2.0, mix(0.3, 0.8, k.z), 31u) * 1.6; }
entries.worley_f2: fn n_worley_f2(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return worley(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, 0, 71u).y * 0.7; }
entries.worley_edge: fn n_worley_edge(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let w = worley(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, 0, 71u); return smoothstep(0.0, mix(0.05, 0.6, k.z), w.y - w.x); }
entries.voronoi_id: fn n_voronoi_id(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let w = worley(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, 0, 71u); return mix(w.z, 0.0, smoothstep(mix(0.2, 0.0, k.z), 0.0, w.y - w.x)); }
entries.worley_manhattan: fn n_worley_manhattan(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return worley(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, 1, 73u).x * 0.8; }
entries.worley_chebyshev: fn n_worley_chebyshev(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return worley(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, 2, 73u).x; }
entries.worley_smooth: fn n_worley_smooth(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return worley_smooth(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, mix(2.0, 40.0, k.y), 79u) * 1.1; }
entries.voronoise: fn n_voronoise(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return voronoise(p * mix(1.0, 10.0, k.x) + t * 0.3 * k.w, k.y, k.z, 83u); }
entries.plaid: fn n_plaid(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let f = mix(2.0, 30.0, k.x); return 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(p.x * f + t * k.z) * sin(p.y * f * mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y) + t * k.z); }
entries.rings: fn n_rings(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(length(p) * mix(4.0, 60.0, k.x) - t * mix(0.0, 6.0, k.y)); }
entries.spiral: fn n_spiral(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let a = atan2(p.y, p.x); return 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(a * floor(mix(1.0, 12.0, k.y)) + length(p) * mix(4.0, 40.0, k.x) - t * mix(0.0, 4.0, k.z)); }
entries.checker: fn n_checker(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = rot2(k.y * PI * 0.5) * p * mix(1.0, 16.0, k.x) + vec2f(t * k.z, 0.0); let c = floor(q); return f32((i32(c.x) + i32(c.y)) & 1); }
entries.stripes_wave: fn n_stripes_wave(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let x = p.x * mix(4.0, 40.0, k.x) + mix(0.0, 4.0, k.y) * sin(p.y * 3.0 + t * k.z); return smoothstep(0.4, 0.6, 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(x)); }
entries.posterize: fn n_posterize(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let v = fbm01(p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.1 * k.w, 4, 2.0, 0.5, 139u); let n = floor(mix(2.0, 12.0, k.y)); return floor(v * n) / (n - 1.0); }
entries.threshold: fn n_threshold(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let v = fbm01(p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.1 * k.w, 4, 2.0, 0.5, 139u); return step(mix(0.3, 0.7, k.y), v); }
entries.bands: fn n_bands(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let v = fbm01(p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.1 * k.w, 4, 2.0, 0.5, 139u); let w = mix(0.02, 0.3, k.z); return smoothstep(0.5 - w, 0.5 + w, 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(v * mix(6.0, 40.0, k.y))); }
entries.marble:
// marble: sin(x + turbulence) — Perlin's original demo.
fn n_marble(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x); return 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(q.x * mix(2.0, 10.0, k.y) + mix(0.0, 8.0, k.z) * turbulence(q + t * 0.05 * k.w, 5, 2.0, 0.5, 149u)); }
entries.wood:
// wood: rings of a distance plus low-frequency noise, sharpened.
fn n_wood(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = p * mix(0.5, 3.0, k.x); let r = length(q + vec2f(0.6, 0.2)) + mix(0.0, 0.6, k.z) * fbm(q * 2.0 + t * 0.05 * k.w, 3, 2.0, 0.5, 151u); return pow(fract(r * mix(3.0, 16.0, k.y)), 0.5); }
entries.sdf_boxes: fn n_sdf_boxes(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = rot2(t * 0.3 * k.w) * (fract(p * mix(0.5, 5.0, k.x)) - 0.5); let d = sdBox(q, vec2f(mix(0.1, 0.4, k.y))) - mix(0.0, 0.15, k.z); return fill(d, 0.01); }
entries.sdf_lines: fn n_sdf_lines(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = fract(p * mix(0.5, 5.0, k.x)) - 0.5; let a = t * 0.5 * k.w; let d = sdSegment(q, vec2f(-0.4, 0.0) * rot2(a), vec2f(0.4, 0.0) * rot2(a)); return fill(d - mix(0.01, 0.15, k.y), mix(0.005, 0.1, k.z)); }
entries.sdf_rings: fn n_sdf_rings(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = fract(p * mix(0.5, 5.0, k.x)) - 0.5; let d = abs(sdCircle(q, mix(0.15, 0.45, k.y))) - mix(0.005, 0.08, k.z); return fill(d, 0.01) * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * k.w * 3.0 + p.x)); }
entries.sdf_star: fn n_sdf_star(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = rot2(t * 0.4 * k.w) * (fract(p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x)) - 0.5); return fill(sdStar5(q, mix(0.15, 0.45, k.y), mix(0.3, 0.9, k.z)), 0.01); }
entries.sdf_ngon: fn n_sdf_ngon(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let q = rot2(t * 0.3 * k.w) * (fract(p * mix(0.5, 4.0, k.x)) - 0.5); return fill(abs(sdNgon(q, mix(0.15, 0.4, k.y), floor(mix(3.0, 9.0, k.z)))) - 0.02, 0.01); }
entries.sdf_blob:
// blob: a circle whose boundary is displaced by fbm — the organic silhouette.
fn n_sdf_blob(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let d = sdCircle(p, mix(0.4, 1.2, k.x)) + mix(0.0, 0.6, k.y) * fbm(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.z) + t * 0.15 * k.w, 4, 2.0, 0.5, 163u); return fill(d, 0.01); }
entries.gabor_noise: fn n_gabor_noise(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.35 * gabor_noise(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.2 * k.w, 1.0, mix(1.0, 6.0, k.y), 0.6, k.z, 4, 167u); }
entries.gabor_aniso: fn n_gabor_aniso(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { return 0.5 + 0.35 * gabor_noise(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.2 * k.w, mix(0.5, 2.0, k.z), mix(1.0, 6.0, k.y), 0.8, 0.0, 4, 173u); }
entries.phasor: fn n_phasor(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let z = phasor(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.2 * k.w, 1.0, mix(1.0, 6.0, k.y), 0.6, k.z, 179u); return 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(atan2(z.y, z.x)); }
entries.phasor_profile: fn n_phasor_profile(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> f32 { let z = phasor(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x) + t * 0.2 * k.w, 1.0, mix(1.0, 6.0, k.y), 0.4, 0.0, 179u); let ph = fract(atan2(z.y, z.x) / TAU); let duty = mix(0.2, 0.8, k.z); return smoothstep(duty - 0.03, duty + 0.03, ph); }

field.label: Field

entries.source: fn v_source(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return p / r2 * mix(0.3, 1.5, k.x) * select(1.0, -1.0, k.y > 0.5); }
entries.vortex: fn v_vortex(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return vec2f(-p.y, p.x) / r2 * mix(0.3, 1.5, k.x); }
entries.rankine: fn v_rankine(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r = length(p); let a = mix(0.15, 0.6, k.x); let w = select(1.0 / max(r, 1e-3), r / (a * a), r < a); return vec2f(-p.y, p.x) / max(r, 1e-3) * w * a * mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y); }
entries.doublet: fn v_doublet(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.005); let r4 = r2 * r2; return vec2f((p.y * p.y - p.x * p.x), -2.0 * p.x * p.y) / r4 * 0.05 * mix(0.3, 2.0, k.x); }
entries.spiral_sink: fn v_spiral_sink(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = max(dot(p, p), 0.01); return (vec2f(-p.y, p.x) * mix(0.0, 1.5, k.x) - p * mix(0.1, 1.0, k.y)) / sqrt(r2); }
entries.taylor_green: fn v_taylor_green(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let f = mix(2.0, 8.0, k.x) * PI; let q = p * 0.5 + 0.5; return vec2f(sin(f * q.x) * cos(f * q.y), -cos(f * q.x) * sin(f * q.y)) * exp(-0.0 * t); }
entries.shear: fn v_shear(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let w = mix(0.05, 0.3, k.y); return vec2f(tanh(p.y / w) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.x) + 0.1 * sin(p.x * 10.0 + t), 0.05 * sin(p.x * 6.0 - t * 0.7) * k.z); }
entries.pendulum: fn v_pendulum(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let th = p.x * PI * 2.0; let w = p.y * 4.0; return vec2f(w / (PI * 2.0), (-sin(th) * mix(2.0, 8.0, k.x) - mix(0.0, 1.5, k.y) * w) / 4.0) * 0.5; }
entries.vanderpol: fn v_vanderpol(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 3.0; let y = p.y * 3.0; let mu = mix(0.2, 2.5, k.x); return vec2f(y, mu * (1.0 - x * x) * y - x) / 3.0 * 0.4; }
entries.duffing: fn v_duffing(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 2.0; let y = p.y * 2.0; let d = mix(0.0, 0.6, k.y); return vec2f(y, x - x * x * x - d * y + mix(0.0, 0.8, k.x) * cos(t * 1.2)) * 0.4; }
entries.lotka: fn v_lotka(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = (p.x + 1.0) * 2.0; let y = (p.y + 1.0) * 2.0; let a = mix(0.8, 1.6, k.x); return vec2f(a * x - x * y, x * y - a * y) * 0.25; }
entries.hopf: fn v_hopf(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let r2 = dot(p, p); let mu = mix(-0.3, 0.6, k.x); return (p * (mu - r2) + vec2f(-p.y, p.x) * mix(0.5, 2.0, k.y)) * 0.7; }
entries.saddle: fn v_saddle(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let a = k.x * PI; return rot2(a) * (vec2f(1.0, -1.0) * (rot2(-a) * p)) * mix(0.5, 1.5, k.y); }
entries.lorenz:
// a projection of the Lorenz flow onto (x, z), y reconstructed from a knob — chaos as a field
fn v_lorenz(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let x = p.x * 25.0; let z = p.y * 25.0 + 25.0; let y = x * mix(0.6, 1.4, k.x); let s = 10.0; let r = 28.0; let b = 8.0 / 3.0; return vec2f(s * (y - x), x * y - b * z) / 25.0 * 0.03; }
entries.gradient: fn v_gradient(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return grad_fbm(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x), t * 0.1 * k.y, 37u) * 0.3 * select(1.0, -1.0, k.z > 0.5); }
entries.curl_plus_stream: fn v_curl_plus_stream(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let g = grad_fbm(p * mix(1.0, 4.0, k.x), t * 0.1, 41u); return vec2f(g.y, -g.x) * mix(0.0, 0.6, k.y) + vec2f(mix(0.2, 1.0, k.z), 0.0); }
entries.wind: fn v_wind(p: vec2f, t: f32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { let g1 = grad_fbm(p * 1.5, t * 0.15, 43u); let g2 = grad_fbm(p * 5.0 + 3.0, t * 0.4, 47u); return vec2f(g1.y, -g1.x) * 0.5 + vec2f(g2.y, -g2.x) * 0.12 * mix(0.0, 2.0, k.x) + vec2f(0.3 + 0.2 * sin(t * 0.5), 0.0) * k.y; }

entries.cp_rotation: fn sample_cp_rotation(i: u32, n: u32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return fract(vec2f(radinv2(i), radinv(i, 3u)) + rnd2(SEED, 11u)); }
entries.hammersley: fn sample_hammersley(i: u32, n: u32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return vec2f((f32(i) + 0.5) / f32(n), radinv2(i)); }
entries.sobol: fn sample_sobol(i: u32, n: u32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return vec2f(radinv2(i), sobol2(i)); }
entries.r2: fn sample_r2(i: u32, n: u32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return fract(vec2f(0.5) + f32(i) * vec2f(0.7548776662, 0.5698402910)); }
entries.fibonacci_lattice: fn sample_fibonacci_lattice(i: u32, n: u32, k: vec4f) -> vec2f { return vec2f((f32(i) + 0.5) / f32(n), fract(f32(i) / PHI)); }

entries.rail:
// —— ramps ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_rail(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { return out(rail(pow(field(cell_uv(fp.xy)), mix(0.5, 2.0, u.k.x)))); }
entries.grey_gamma: @fragment fn fs_grey_gamma(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(vec3f(pow(t, mix(0.3, 3.0, u.k.x)))); }
entries.hsv_sweep:
// —— spaces ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_hsv_sweep(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(hsv2rgb(t + u.time * 0.03, mix(0.5, 1.0, u.k.x), mix(0.6, 1.0, u.k.y))); }
entries.oklch_sweep:
// the same hue sweep at constant OKLCH lightness and chroma — no dark blue / bright yellow bias
@fragment fn fs_oklch_sweep(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(oklch(mix(0.5, 0.85, u.k.y), mix(0.05, 0.2, u.k.x), t * TAU + u.time * 0.2)); }
entries.clip: @fragment fn fs_clip(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { return out(linear_to_srgb(clamp(hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)), vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0)))); }
entries.reinhard: @fragment fn fs_reinhard(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(linear_to_srgb(c / (1.0 + c))); }
entries.reinhard_ext: @fragment fn fs_reinhard_ext(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let w = mix(2.0, 16.0, u.k.y); return out(linear_to_srgb(c * (1.0 + c / (w * w)) / (1.0 + c))); }
entries.aces: @fragment fn fs_aces(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let m = (c * (2.51 * c + 0.03)) / (c * (2.43 * c + 0.59) + 0.14); return out(linear_to_srgb(clamp(m, vec3f(0.0), vec3f(1.0)))); }
entries.hable: @fragment fn fs_hable(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let c = hdr(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let W = vec3f(11.2); return out(linear_to_srgb(hable(c * 2.0) / hable(W))); }
entries.posterize:
// —— quantize / dither ——————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_posterize(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = floor(mix(2.0, 12.0, u.k.x)); return out(rail(floor(t * n + 0.5) / n)); }
entries.ign_dither: @fragment fn fs_ign_dither(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = floor(mix(1.0, 5.0, u.k.x)); return out(rail(floor(t * n + ign(floor(fp.xy / mix(1.0, 4.0, u.k.y)))) / n)); }
entries.duotone: @fragment fn fs_duotone(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(select(u.ink.rgb, u.cream.rgb, t + (ign(fp.xy) - 0.5) * u.k.y > mix(0.3, 0.7, u.k.x))); }
entries.contours: @fragment fn fs_contours(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); let n = mix(4.0, 20.0, u.k.x); let f = fract(t * n); let line = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, min(f, 1.0 - f)); return out(mix(rail(floor(t * n) / n), u.cream.rgb, line * u.k.y)); }
entries.cycle:
// —— effects ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
@fragment fn fs_cycle(@builtin(position) fp: vec4f) -> @location(0) vec4f { let t = field(cell_uv(fp.xy)); return out(rail(fract(t * mix(1.0, 4.0, u.k.x) - u.time * 0.3))); }
